title: Glyph Mapping
description: Glyph Mapping is a language ability in the Ancient Language Emulation Layers database. Maps ancient glyphs to modern code points without losing distinctions. Each glyph gets a unique code point; lookalikes are kept distinct by variant selectors. It takes glyph inventory and produces mapping table. Tunable parameters: per glyph. Guarantee: no two distinct glyphs ever merge.
